g.text: Online Shop Project — Full Class Diagram
+PersonalComputer(name, price, stock, weight, dimensions, processorModel, ramCapacityGB)
+FlashMemory(name, price, stock, weight, dimensions, capacityGB, usbVersion)
+SSD(name, price, stock, weight, dimensions, capacityGB, readSpeedMBps, writeSpeedMBps)
+addToCart(buyer : Buyer, productId : String, quantity : int) : void
+submitComment(buyer : Buyer, product : Product, text : String) : Comment
+submitRating(buyer : Buyer, product : Product, score : int) : Rating
Invoice, Request (and all their subclasses) implement
the entire shop state to/from disk between runs.
is the composition root: it instantiates every
repository, service, view, and controller shown above and
wires them together, then loads saved data via
PersistenceService (or calls DataSeeder if no save file
exists yet) before starting the menu loop.
